description: This file defines a utility object SplitUtils with functions to split a string into tokens separated by spaces and store them in a custom LinkedList.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing methods to split strings into tokens.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a given string into tokens separated by spaces and returns a LinkedList of tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it is considered valid.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks whether a given token is valid (non-empty).
